description: NaHoO₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/amd space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent HoO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent HoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. There are four shorter (2.30 Å) and two longer (2.81 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ho³⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form HoO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent HoO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent HoO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. There are two shorter (2.26 Å) and four longer (2.30 Å) Ho-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Ho³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Ho₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. There are two shorter (2.30 Å) and one longer (2.81 Å) O-Na bond length. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Ho³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Ho₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. In the third O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Ho³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Ho₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. In the fourth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Ho³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Ho₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. There is one shorter (2.26 Å) and two longer (2.30 Å) O-Ho bond lengths.
